question: average heart rate value per patient over the last 24 hours
goldSql: SELECT m."patientRef", AVG(m."Value") AS avg_hr FROM mock.public."MeasurementsMock" m JOIN mock.public."MeasurementTypeRef" t ON m."MeasurementTypeId" = t."MeasurementTypeId" WHERE t."name" = 'Heart Rate' AND m."RecordedAt" >= now() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY m."patientRef" ORDER BY m."patientRef" LIMIT 1000

question: count of measurements per measurement type in the last 7 days
goldSql: SELECT t."name", COUNT(*) AS measurement_count FROM mock.public."MeasurementsMock" m JOIN mock.public."MeasurementTypeRef" t ON m."MeasurementTypeId" = t."MeasurementTypeId" WHERE m."RecordedAt" >= now() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY t."name" ORDER BY t."name" LIMIT 1000

question: which patients are in ward ICU-A
goldSql: SELECT p."patientRef", p."patientCode" FROM mock.public."PatientMock" p JOIN mock.public."WardRef" w ON p."wardId" = w."WardId" WHERE w."name" = 'ICU-A' LIMIT 1000

question: patients at hospitals in the North region
goldSql: SELECT p."patientRef", p."hospitalId" FROM mock.public."PatientMock" p JOIN mock.public."HospitalRef" h ON p."hospitalId" = h."HospitalId" WHERE h."region" = 'North' LIMIT 1000

question: visits joined through patients to their hospital name
goldSql: SELECT v."visitRef", h."name" AS hospital_name FROM mock.public."VisitMock" v JOIN mock.public."PatientMock" p ON v."patientRef" = p."patientRef" JOIN mock.public."HospitalRef" h ON p."hospitalId" = h."HospitalId" LIMIT 1000

question: oxygen saturation below 90 in the last hour
goldSql: SELECT DISTINCT m."patientRef" FROM mock.public."MeasurementsMock" m JOIN mock.public."MeasurementTypeRef" t ON m."MeasurementTypeId" = t."MeasurementTypeId" WHERE t."name" = 'SpO2' AND m."Value" < 90 AND m."RecordedAt" >= now() - INTERVAL '1 hour' LIMIT 1000

question: patients discharged in the last 7 days
goldSql: SELECT v."visitRef", v."patientRef", v."dischargedAt" FROM mock.public."VisitMock" v WHERE v."dischargedAt" >= now() - INTERVAL '7 days' LIMIT 1000

question: count of patients grouped by age band
goldSql: SELECT p."ageBand", COUNT(*) AS patient_count FROM mock.public."PatientMock" p GROUP BY p."ageBand" ORDER BY p."ageBand" LIMIT 1000
